account-locked: Akhaunthu yo valelwa lwa tshifhinganyana nga u kundelwa u dzhena lunzhi. Lingedzani hafhu nga murahu.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ndi ya SuperAdmin fhedzi, kha domeini ya Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Nga WeKan kha Weddy, Cloud Panel i shumela domeini nnzhi dza WeKan u bva kha seva nthihi, iṅwe na iṅwe i na data yayo. Kha domeini ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin u langa domeini na CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Nga khii ya CloudFlare API, domeini ine zone yayo ya vha kha akhaunthu yaṋu ya CloudFlare i wana rekhodo ya DNS ya proxy na thanziela ya CloudFlare Origin. Dziṅwe domeini dzi wana thanziela ya Let's Encrypt. Khii i vhulungwa kha seva nahone a i tsha sumbedzwa hu ḽa.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: A hu na khii ya CloudFlare API yo vhulungwaho: domeini iṅwe na iṅwe i wana thanziela ya Let's Encrypt.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Khii ya CloudFlare API yo vhulungwa.
error-ldap-login: Ho vha na vhukhakhi musi hu tshi lingedzwa u dzhena
error-notAuthorized: A ni na thendelo ya u vhona siaṱari iḽi.
